review.note: Written by hand because the import had the point and no name it could read: Q4117011 carries its own P625 and names no settlement, no country with a point and no class the places table knows, so the event was left placeless with the africa lane. The name is the one its own article gives — “Battle of Wadi al-Laban”, revision 1370276629: “It took place north of Fes, at Wadi al-Laban, an affluent of the Sebou River, one day north of Fes.” The point is the event item's own and the lane is derived.
